answer: Eratosthenes sized Earth from one shadow: 7.2 degrees over 5,000 stadia. Each ballot plants a quill at dawn; at solar zenith it logs its shortest shadow, length and bearing. Fifty yarrow stalks cast each tide pick the minute, so farms can't precompute it. Clone quills die by the zenith check: two shadows matching to half a degree and two centimetres were planted by one hand, so both are cut down, bonds forfeit. Faking 10,000 ballots means 10,000 quills in 10,000 places, $25 locked behind each — $250,000 held hostage. A shadow copied twice is a sundial lying about noon.
